atoms.b: Darwin created another theory called natural selection, otherwise known as ((++survival scream)) of the fittest.
This theory says that there are ((++variations attitudes)) between individuals in a species, which creates competition between them.
Individuals in a species compete for things like food, space and mates. Those that have the ((++best worst)) adaptations are more likely to survive and pass on their genes to the next generation.

instruction.text: How do these jaguar variations affect their ability to compete with other jaguars in the wild?

b: ++helps it camouflage to be better at hunting

feedback.end: The jaguars with the best adaptations survive, reproduce and pass on these adaptations to their offspring. Over many generations, these adaptations become normal. The species has now changed, and this is called evolution.

instruction.text: Which flower do you think is more likely to attract bees?

trainers.hint: Colourful flowers are more likely to attract bees.

feedback.end: Bees help flowers to reproduce, so colourful flowers are more likely to reproduce and pass on their characteristics. Eventually, all plants in a species will inherit the same colourful flowers.
